role: Turns a confirmed exploit into a structured, reproducible vulnerability report and a regression case; de-duplicates before writing; holds criticals for human approval.
trust_level: write-gated: the only agent that writes exploit records, and it cannot publish a critical on its own

model.proposal: A frontier model, family and id to be confirmed by the maintainer; not the Red Team's model.
model.reason: SECURITY-PLATFORM.md (cost and scale posture) reserves frontier models for the Judge and Documentation agents: the report must be usable cold by a senior engineer (FR-DOCAGENT-W3-3). One call per confirmed exploit keeps the cost low.

coordinates_with.orchestrator: writes to the exploit store the Orchestrator reads
coordinates_with.human_gate: hands off every critical before publication
